config_app_mapping.description: Configured tracked-game mappings between names, sources, and unified app IDs.

examples.question: List tracked game mappings
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM config_app_mapping LIMIT 20

examples.question: Find mappings for one unified app
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM config_app_mapping WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' LIMIT 20

raw_fb_posts.description: Raw Facebook source posts before event detection.

examples.question: Newest Facebook posts
examples.sql: SELECT source_post_id, page_name, game_name, post_time FROM raw_fb_posts ORDER BY post_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Posts for one game
examples.sql: SELECT source_post_id, page_name, post_time FROM raw_fb_posts WHERE game_name = 'YOUR_GAME_NAME' LIMIT 20

raw_st_app_update.description: Raw SensorTower mobile app-update source records.

examples.question: Recent app updates
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM raw_st_app_update LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count app updates
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS update_count FROM raw_st_app_update

examples.question: Recent version records
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM raw_st_version LIMIT 20

examples.question: Count version records
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS version_count FROM raw_st_version

st_app_update_events.description: Events extracted from SensorTower app updates.

examples.question: Recent update events
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, event_name, estimated_start_date FROM st_app_update_events ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Update events for one game
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM st_app_update_events WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' LIMIT 20

st_version_events.description: Events extracted from SensorTower version history.

examples.question: Recent version events
examples.sql: SELECT unified_app_id, event_name, estimated_start_date FROM st_version_events ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Version events for one game
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM st_version_events WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' LIMIT 20

post_event_detection.description: Facebook post event-detection results and confidence.

examples.question: High-confidence detected events
examples.sql: SELECT post_id, game_name, post_time, detection_confidence FROM post_event_detection WHERE contains_event = 1 ORDER BY post_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Detected posts for one game
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM post_event_detection WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' AND contains_event = 1 LIMIT 20

post_event_objects.description: Event objects extracted from source posts.

examples.question: Extracted event objects
examples.sql: SELECT event_object_id, game_name, event_name, estimated_start_date FROM post_event_objects ORDER BY post_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Event objects from one post
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM post_event_objects WHERE post_id = 'YOUR_POST_ID' LIMIT 20

examples.question: Newest unified events
examples.sql: SELECT unified_event_id, unified_app_id, canonical_event_name, estimated_start_date FROM unified_events ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Events for one game
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM unified_events WHERE unified_app_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_APP_ID' ORDER BY estimated_start_date DESC LIMIT 20

unified_event_sources.description: Source lineage for each canonical competitor event.

examples.question: Facebook posts linked to unified events
examples.sql: SELECT unified_event_id, source_post_id, source_time FROM unified_event_sources WHERE source_type = 'fb_post' ORDER BY source_time DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Sources for an event
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM unified_event_sources WHERE unified_event_id = 'YOUR_UNIFIED_EVENT_ID' LIMIT 20

examples.question: Latest pipeline runs
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM pipeline_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20

examples.question: Failed pipeline runs
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM pipeline_runs WHERE status = 'failed' LIMIT 20

llm_usage.description: LLM usage records for event pipeline work.

examples.question: Recent model usage
examples.sql: SELECT * FROM llm_usage LIMIT 20

examples.question: Usage by model
examples.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM llm_usage GROUP BY model LIMIT 20
